A direct adjacency-based brute-force implementation exactly reproduced 136 bivariate profiles; 447 parameter cases match the sharp chi formula. No finite checks are misrepresented as universal proof.

value.rationale: The polynomial counts every named-color PCF configuration of a natural three-parameter bipartite family, refining by cross-shore shared colors; the zero-singleton exception creates a nontrivial perfect-doubleton partition term. It establishes complete sharp chromatic thresholds and nontrivial color-sector profiles, which published chi-only and parity-odd results do not imply. It is a complete motivated infinite-family invariant, not a routine numerical increment.
